chunks: This was so because their apostles came with clear proofs to them, but they refused to believe. So they were seized by God. Surely God is powerful, unrelenting in retribution.
ai.seo_question: Why did God punish the Children of Israel despite sending them prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-bayinat' (clear proofs) refers not only to miracles but also to the inherent authority of the Imams, whom the Israelites often rejected despite their evident status. This verse underscores the principle that divine punishment follows the rejection of clear guidance, highlighting Allah's absolute power (Qawi) and the severity of His retribution against those who persist in disbelief.
